about_the_game:
War has returned to the Earth, and no one will save us but ourselves.

Project Red Sun is a combat flight action game with emphasis on punchy, arcade gameplay inspired from the flight sims of the 90s, made by people who have done it before.

As "Wildcat 1" of the First Republic's Air Vangaurd, lead your flight in an all-out battle for the survival of the free world against the all-consuming Coalition. Across 20+ missions, dogfight, strike and lead the charge against a system brought to its inevitable cruelty while facing down airships, mercenaries, mega-structures, and more. 

With a bespoke inventory of aircraft and weapons at your disposal, you will join forces with the best of Humanity, flying across the world, from Kurdistan to Kansas, all in the name of a better future.

Key Features:

  • Fly over every corner of a real, but forever changed, world.

  • Single player campaign with 20+ missions.

  • Different enemy types ranging from super structures, to airships, to "collectible" enemy aces.

  • An escalating, stage-rush, boss-fight tower climb known as "Wildcat Mode".

  • Over a dozen specially designed aircraft with a myriad of variants and paint schemes.

  • 40+ familiar and new weapons to level the playing field.

  • Fully playable in VR.

  • Destroy the city of Cleveland.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Project Red Sun is a combat flight action game that has you fighting across the world as a heroic ace against corporate armies who will spare no expense in trying to take you down. With specialized jets and weaponry, dogfight aces, airships, and more in a campaign packed with arcade gameplay.
